baseline_models.focus_anchor: The chain زَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ... أَعْمَالَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ contrasts directly with وَكَانُوا مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A rebellious agent alters the felt value of intentional conduct: once their own deeds appear attractive, motivation turns away from the traversable course even while inward recognition remains available.

activation_trace.role: Making attractiveness outwardly perceptible supplies the evaluative coating placed over their conduct.
The insolent rebel supplies the personal agency directing that evaluative distortion.
Intentional doing supplies the morally accountable material whose appearance is manipulated.
Turning or holding someone away supplies the transition from favorable appraisal to obstructed movement.
A route extending toward a goal supplies the normative course from which they are displaced.
Penetrating inward discernment remains present, locating failure after recognition rather than before it.

changed_reading.before: Satan concealed the right road from people who did not know better.
changed_reading.after: The road could be recognized, but aesthetic approval of self-authored deeds captured desire and prevented recognized truth from governing movement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قَد تَّبَيَّنَ لَكُم مِن مَّسَاكِنِهِمْ addresses later viewers, whereas وَكَانُوا مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ describes the earlier inhabitants.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah stages a temporal reversal of sight: discernment that failed to redirect the inhabitants becomes materially legible to later observers through their settled places.

activation_trace.role: Emergence into clarity marks what becomes readable to the later addressees.
An inhabited place supplies the durable material archive from which that clarity is drawn.
Their prior diversion explains why knowledge had to pass to a later audience through material residue.
A state fixed in past time separates the inhabitants' discernment from the audience's present disclosure.
Their inward awareness supplies the failed first-person sight that is converted into second-person warning.

changed_reading.before: The dwellings merely provide external information about the named peoples.
changed_reading.after: The dwellings relay an unacted-on insight across time: what insiders saw without following becomes a visible lesson for outsiders.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَسَاكِنِهِمْ, ٱلشَّيْطَانُ, فَصَدَّهُمْ, and ٱلسَّبِيلِ form a spatial sequence of settlement, distance, barrier, and route.
baseline_models.mechanism: Beautified practice fixes people into a settled configuration; the distancing aspect activated by the adversarial figure and the ensuing barrier turn moral error into a topology of attachment, separation, and arrested travel.

activation_trace.role: Cessation of motion supplies the stasis into which pleasing practice settles its agents.
Displayed attractiveness makes the stationary configuration feel desirable rather than confining.
Remoteness and severance supply the spatial effect produced by the adversarial agency.
The defiant agent gives that production of distance an intentional source.
Active prevention turns mere distance into a functioning barrier.
The traversable course supplies the movement that this system arrests.

changed_reading.before: The devil supplies a false proposition and the victims choose the wrong idea.
changed_reading.after: The ayah depicts a spatial capture system: attractive habits produce stasis, distance, and a barrier between discernment and movement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening image of testing a person as material activates the dwellings as a durable test report: claimed orientation is assayed through conduct, and the built residue makes the result visible.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure in the focus supplies the readable result of the earlier assay.
The settled site supplies a material surface on which that result persists.
Assaying metal or a person supplies the cross-domain model of pressure revealing concealed quality.
Truth completed in action makes conduct, rather than profession alone, the test's decisive output.
Departure from truth supplies the contrasting failed output disclosed by the same test.

structural_cues: The opening sequence contrasts an untested spoken profession with a test that distinguishes truthful from false.
The focus relocates disclosure from what a people say to what their settled places make inspectable.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a human/material assay, truth realized in action, and clarity read from dwellings; I infer test → lived output → material report. The live alternative is that the test denotes affliction only and the dwellings are ordinary evidence.

changed_reading.before: The residences are passive remains from which a historical fact can be inferred.
changed_reading.after: They are the hardened readout of an assay in which professed understanding was tested by whether it redirected action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The blocked route becomes socially governed: a group recruits others into 'our path,' offers a false guarantee against liability, and binds the arrangement with affection; the closing guided 'ways' reverse that captured ownership.

activation_trace.role: Making conduct look good supplies the persuasive surface by which a communal route attracts adherents.
Active diversion supplies the exclusionary effect of that social recruitment.
A route toward an end supplies the contested object of communal guidance.
Following in another's wake supplies the bodily-social mechanics of recruitment.
The possessively claimed route turns a general course into a group's offered way.
A purported guarantee to bear another's burden lowers the perceived cost of joining.
Interpersonal affection supplies the adhesive that makes the shared false order feel desirable.
Angry expulsion exposes the eventual reversal of the bonds that had beautified the arrangement.
Gentle direction toward truth supplies the counter-agency that reopens movement.
The final plural routes replace the group's captured path with divinely directed avenues.

structural_cues: A recruiting voice says 'our path,' while the surah closes with the promise of guidance into 'Our ways.'
Promised burden-transfer precedes an affection-based alliance whose members later repudiate and curse one another.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recruitment, promised burden-bearing, affinity, later expulsion, and final guidance; I supply social loyalty → beautified conduct → route capture. A live alternative is that these are separate examples and the satanic act remains private persuasion.

changed_reading.before: Each person is privately lured away from an abstract moral road.
changed_reading.after: Diversion is socially distributed through belonging, liability promises, and rival claims over which communal route deserves to be followed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The explicit beginning-and-return sequence before the historical list activates a formal echo around the proper name عَاد: the named case remains a name, yet it begins to sound like a recurrence of a repeatable human pattern.

activation_trace.role: The proper-name branch fixes the token as the historical name and prevents the echo from replacing its referent.
Present disclosure makes the named past available as a pattern legible to current viewers.
Beginning explicitly paired with repetition establishes a start-and-return frame.
Coming back after an initial occurrence supplies the recurrence that resonates with the later name.
Travel across the land makes recurrence something encountered through movement rather than abstract chronology.
Directed sight and reflection supply the readerly act that detects the repeated pattern.

structural_cues: Creation is described as beginning and then being repeated immediately before the command to travel and inspect.
The later proper name shares the supplied lexical family with the explicit verb of return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a proper-name branch, an explicit return occurrence, and a beginning-return sequence; I infer that the sound-family echo makes one named history recur as warning. The live alternative is that the proper name is semantically inert here.

changed_reading.before: Ad is one closed item in a sequence of ancient peoples.
changed_reading.after: Without ceasing to be a proper name, Ad becomes an acoustic hinge by which the closed incident feels liable to return in later communities.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's dwellings become terminal positions in a mobility sequence: compromised attachment arrests departure, migration breaks the enclosure, immobile bodies and retained traces expose the failed settlement, and a new lodging is later assigned rather than self-secured.

activation_trace.role: Loss of motion makes the dwelling a terminal state rather than merely an address.
Settlement in a home supplies the concrete place where allegiance becomes materially fixed.
The traversable route supplies the unrealized possibility of leaving that fixed configuration.
Departure from one abode toward another supplies the counter-movement to corrupt fixation.
Leaving an effect behind explains how a vanished social order remains readable in place.
Clinging to the ground and remaining in place literalizes the endpoint of arrested movement.
Spatial expansiveness reopens the possibility of worship beyond a constraining locality.
Receiving a prepared lodging supplies the constructive alternative to self-enclosing settlement.

structural_cues: Migration away from an idol-bound order precedes the sequence of ruined localities.
Immediately before the focus, inhabitants end adhered to the ground in their home; later the earth is declared spacious and a new abode is assigned.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies emigration, a retained trace, earth-bound bodies, expansive land, and assigned lodging; I infer attachment → arrested path and faithful departure → reopened path → resettlement. The alternative is simple narrative adjacency without a mobility mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The dwellings only prove what happened to former inhabitants.
changed_reading.after: A dwelling records a trajectory: whether allegiance trapped its occupants in place or whether departure allowed them to be lodged within a different order.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated combinations of clear evidence, internal knowledge, verbal correctness, arrogance, informed denial, and directional inversion confirm that the focus describes compartmentalized insight rather than simple ignorance.

activation_trace.role: Manifest clarity establishes that relevant evidence can genuinely become available.
Evaluative beautification explains how available evidence can lose practical authority.
Diversion supplies the behavioral break between recognition and alignment.
Inward verification anchors the claim that some genuine cognition survives the diversion.
Multiple manifest proofs repeat the availability of disclosure immediately after the focus.
Self-magnifying pride supplies a motive for refusing what the proofs disclose.
Knowledge as disclosure to an informed subject makes the signs internally possessed, not merely external.
Denial exercised with knowledge supplies the clearest analogue for sight that does not govern allegiance.
An articulated correct answer shows propositional recognition surviving in speech.
Being turned from the proper face supplies the directional failure following that correct answer.
Intellect as a restraint identifies the missing conversion of knowledge into checked conduct.

structural_cues: Clear proofs are followed by pride rather than by evidential uncertainty.
Signs can be held inwardly and still be denied.
Questioners elicit the correct creator-answer, yet the speakers remain turned away and fail to reason through it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies evidence, possessed knowledge, correct speech, pride, informed denial, and turning; I infer that adornment interrupts knowledge → valuation → commitment. A live alternative is that مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ means only worldly shrewdness rather than relevant moral insight.

changed_reading.before: Their being discerning is an ironic flourish or merely a statement of intelligence.
changed_reading.after: Their insight is materially live but compartmentalized: they can recognize, articulate, and even internalize truth while refusing its directional claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The spider analogy turns beautified works and dwellings into an engineering problem: an intricate self-made support can be real and visually impressive while lacking the strength to bear the protective load assigned to it.

activation_trace.role: The home supplies the material category whose protective performance is placed under review.
Visible improvement of appearance supplies the mismatch between attractive form and actual capacity.
Purposeful work supplies the constructed output that agents may mistake for reliable protection.
A formally presented analogy licenses transferring structural features from the spider's case to human reliance.
Acquiring a support and the spider making a house share a taking-action that links allegiance with construction.
Loved and supporting allies supply the protective load entrusted to the constructed arrangement.
The weaving creature supplies the image of elaborate production whose output is being assessed.
A sheltering home supplies the promised function of the web-like alliance.
Loss of strength and resolve supplies the verdict that the structure cannot perform its protective claim.

structural_cues: The same taking construction governs human allies and the spider's house.
The shelter is not denied existence or intricacy; it is judged weakest specifically as a house.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies taken allies, a woven house, weakness, beautified deeds, and former dwellings; I infer visible intricacy → presumed load-bearing power → failed refuge. The alternative is that the analogy concerns allies alone and does not revise the focus's 'works.'

changed_reading.before: Satan makes morally ugly deeds appear aesthetically good.
changed_reading.after: He induces a structural category error: the polish and intricacy of what people build are treated as proof that it can shelter them.

context_deltas.mechanism: A remote ocular branch of ٱلسَّبِيلِ, activated by the nearby weaving spider and the focus's sight clause, overlays the external road with a thin visual membrane: perception continues, but it is patterned by what covers it.

activation_trace.role: Applied attractiveness supplies the pleasing appearance of the perceptual layer.
The ordinary traversable route remains the primary object from which movement is blocked.
A filmy ocular obstruction patterned like weaving supplies a secondary visual mode of that blockage.
Actual eyesight remains active, allowing obstruction to function as filtering rather than total blindness.
The web-producing creature supplies the concrete woven texture that activates the ocular image.
The web's weakness makes the filter thin yet still capable of misdirecting sight.

structural_cues: The focus places route-blocking immediately beside a declaration that the people possessed sight or insight.
A nearby analogy foregrounds a web-producing creature and a structure whose appearance exceeds its strength.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ocular-film branch, explicit sight, beautification, and a nearby web image; I infer web-like layer → filtered valuation → missed route. The live alternative is the dominant reading in which ٱلسَّبِيلِ is only a road and the ocular branch contributes nothing.

changed_reading.before: The path is an external road blocked despite intact vision.
changed_reading.after: The phrase briefly supports a double exposure: the external route is missed because intact sight operates through an attractive, web-like filter.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later making and tasting language turns adornment into a temporal sensory loop: conduct is fashioned into an attractive present identity, but the agent eventually experiences the actual quality of that same product.

activation_trace.role: Making deeds appear attractive supplies their misleading present sensory value.
Purposeful conduct supplies the object that persists across present appraisal and later experience.
Crafting an output reinforces the treatment of conduct as something agents actively produce.
Fashioning one's appearance activates the possibility that conduct also manufactures a pleasing moral persona.
Experiential testing supplies the later encounter with the deed's unadorned quality.
The repeated intentional-doing term identifies what is finally experienced with what was earlier beautified.

structural_cues: A counter-practice is said to restrain indecency before the assertion that God knows what people manufacture.
Later the imperative to taste takes 'what you were doing' as its explanatory object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies beautified deeds, manufactured comportment, and later tasting of deeds; I infer attractive anticipation now → repeated production → corrective experience later. The alternative is that tasting is only a conventional punishment metaphor and manufacturing means ordinary doing.

changed_reading.before: Adorning deeds is a static cosmetic misdescription.
changed_reading.after: It front-loads a false pleasant experience into action, while the later tasting of the same action reverses that sensory valuation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because عَادًا is explicitly secured as a proper name while recurrence belongs to another supplied branch. It remains valid as a formal activation because an earlier occurrence explicitly denotes return and is paired with beginning. Downstream prose should call it an acoustic or lexical-family echo, never translate the name as 'return.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The proper-name occurrence عَادًا is the point at which the earlier beginning-and-return sequence can resonate without replacing the name.

activation_trace.role: The proper-name value preserves the historical referent while hosting the secondary resonance.
The explicit pairing of inception with repetition prepares a cyclical frame.
Return after a beginning supplies the sound-family echo that makes the later case feel repeatable.

changed_reading.before: The proper name marks only one past population.
changed_reading.after: The name also sounds, very cautiously, as a warning that the configuration exemplified by that population can recur.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because ٱلسَّبِيلِ plainly functions as a route, whereas the selected branch concerns an ocular film. It remains anchored to that exact focus occurrence and is activated by the nearby spider, beautification, and retained sight. Render it only as a secondary image overlay, not as an alternative translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَكَانُوا مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ places the potentially web-like obstruction directly against continuing sight.

activation_trace.role: A woven-looking ocular film supplies the image of seeing through a distorting layer.
Continuing eyesight keeps the model one of filtered perception rather than blindness.
The web-making creature supplies the contextual texture that activates the remote visual branch.

changed_reading.before: An intact observer is simply kept away from an external road.
changed_reading.after: The observer may also be imagined as looking through a pleasing web-like film that leaves sight intact while reshaping what the road looks worth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the counting image comes from the non-dominant split mapping of a proper-name token. It remains inspectably anchored because the packet licenses that target and the later sequence gathers every named case and matches each to its offense. Render it as an enumerative echo or ledger effect, not as an etymology of the name.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عَادًا opens a serial list that is later gathered under فَكُلًّا and individualized by each offense.

activation_trace.role: Counting discrete items lets the name-token participate formally in the list's itemizing rhythm.
Comprehensive totality gathers the separately named figures into one complete account.
The individual offense supplies the charge against which each listed case is reckoned.

changed_reading.before: Ad and Thamud are loosely accumulated examples.
changed_reading.after: The list acquires the feel of an itemized moral account in which every case is counted and matched to its own deed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the mirror-linked eye-cosmetic branch belongs to a remote nominal scope, not the causative verb فَصَدَّهُمْ. It remains anchored through that exact occurrence's lexical inventory and the focus's tight beauty-and-sight frame, reinforced by later self-fashioning language. Prose should present it only as an image-level resonance, never as the verb's lexical meaning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: زَيَّنَ ... فَصَدَّهُمْ ... مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ permits a contained cosmetic-perceptual echo around the act of obstruction.

activation_trace.role: Applied beautification supplies the cosmetic operation that makes self-produced conduct pleasing.
A mirror-mediated eye cosmetic supplies an image of reflected self-appearance altering the organ of sight.
The seeing eye supplies the faculty upon which the imagined cosmetic filter operates.
Self-fashioning and adornment reinforce the model of conduct manufacturing its own attractive appearance.

changed_reading.before: Diversion is an obstacle located wholly outside the observer.
changed_reading.after: At image level, self-adornment resembles eye cosmetic applied through a mirror: the pleasing reflection of one's deeds becomes the filter through which one sees.

strongest_changes: The central failure moved from ignorance to a break between genuine recognition, evaluative desire, and committed movement.
The singular blocked path became a socially governed route system involving recruitment, false guarantees, communal affection, severance, and eventual divine guidance.
Dwellings changed from passive evidence into materialized trajectories: arrested habitation, retained test result, fragile refuge, and possible resettlement.
The spider analogy made beautification a structural category error in which visible intricacy is mistaken for protective strength.
summary.what_was_special: The focus triangulates clarity for later viewers, discernment in former actors, and an intervening beauty-to-barrier mechanism. Context activates this tension through assays, rival routes, migration, built shelters, informed denial, and embodied consequences, while the proper-name return echo and the web-like ocular branch remain contained but live.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ denotes genuine relevant insight, worldly shrewdness, or a self-certifying posture remains materially open.
The recurrence resonance around عَادًا may be a formal activation rather than intended wordplay.
The ocular-film and mirror-cosmetic readings depend on remote branch scopes and should not displace the dominant route and diversion senses.
The habitation sequence may encode a deliberate mobility mechanism, or its coherence may arise partly from narrative adjacency.
